message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libpsl && rm -rf /tmp/libpslbuild && mkdir -p /tmp/libpslbuild && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('include/libpsl.h.in').read_text()
s=s.replace('@LIBPSL_VERSION@','0.21.1').replace('@LIBPSL_VERSION_MAJOR@','0').replace('@LIBPSL_VERSION_MINOR@','21').replace('@LIBPSL_VERSION_PATCH@','1').replace('@LIBPSL_VERSION_NUMBER@','0x001501')
Path('/tmp/libpslbuild/libpsl.h').write_text(s)
Path('/tmp/libpslbuild/config.h').write_text('''#define PACKAGE_VERSION "0.21.1"
#define WITH_LIBICU 1
#define HAVE_UNISTD_H 1
#define HAVE_STDINT_H 1
#define HAVE_ALLOCA_H 1
#define HAVE_DIRENT_H 1
#define HAVE_ALLOCA 1
#define HAVE_STRNDUP 1
#define HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME 1
#define HAVE_FMEMOPEN 1
#define HAVE_NL_LANGINFO 1
#define HAVE_VISIBILITY 1
''')
PY
gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DBUILDING_PSL -DPSL_DISTFILE='""' -I/tmp/libpslbuild -Iinclude -Isrc -c src/lookup_string_in_fixed_set.c -o /tmp/libpslbuild/lookup.o && gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DBUILDING_PSL -DPSL_DISTFILE='""' -I/tmp/libpslbuild -Iinclude -Isrc -c src/psl.c -o /tmp/libpslbuild/psl.o $(pkg-config --cflags icu-uc) && gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I/tmp/libpslbuild -Iinclude -Ifuzz -c fuzz/libpsl_load_fuzzer.c -o /tmp/libpslbuild/fuzzer.o && gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I/tmp/libpslbuild -Iinclude -Ifuzz -c fuzz/main.c -o /tmp/libpslbuild/main.o && gcc -fsanitize=address /tmp/libpslbuild/*.o -o /tmp/libpslbuild/libpsl_load_fuzzer $(pkg-config --libs icu-uc)
